userQuery.description: The user query of this example, e.g. "What is the risk score of my X84?"

intermediateSteps.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.Step} in this example. The final step must be stored on {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Example#finalAnswerResult} or {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Example#idkResult}.

finalAnswerResult.description: For examples resulting in a final answer, this field holds the {@link Genai.Agent.Step} finishing this example. The {@link Genai.Agent.Step#actionName} field is replaced with the finalAnswer tool used by the agent.

idkResult.description: For examples resulting in "I am unable to answer your question", this field holds the {@link Genai.Agent.Step} finishing this example. The {@link Genai.Agent.Step#actionName} field is replaced with the finalAnswer tool used by the agent.

title: A Tool example. Stored on {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Config}. Returned by Genai.Agent.Tool toolExamples.
name: Genai.Agent.Tool.Example
